Profile Fibrinogen has been used to control haemorrhage associated with low blood-fibrinogen concentration in afibrinogenaemia or hypofibrinogenaemia although plasma or cryoprecipitate is usu- ally preferred. Fibrinogen has also been used in disseminated in- travascular coagulation (p.1048). It is a component of fibrin glue (see Fibrin, above). Recombinant human fibrinogen is under in- vestigation. Fibrinogen labelled with radionuclides has also been used in di- agnostic procedures. Preparations Ph. Eur.: Fibrin Sealant Kit; Human Fibrinogen.
